item.title: Oil prices fall despite Iran's ongoing attacks on tankers
item.description: Despite Iran claiming daily attacks on takers around the Strait of Hormuz and escalating fighting between the Saudis and Iran's Houthi allies, oil prices continue to decline.

item.title: Top Denmark court upholds "non-Western" evictions law
item.description: Denmark's Supreme Court has upheld a law that lets authorities limit the number of "non-Western" residents who can live in a public housing development.

item.title: Beloved drive-thru worker on making a year's salary on last day of work
item.description: When Sighle Williams decided to retire from Mac's Drive Thru after 37 years, she never could have expected the send-off she received, which is the focus of a new Netflix documentary.

item.title: How China may have exploited a loophole to access Nvidia chips
item.description: The Nvidia spy scandal is raising questions about how China may have gained access to American-made AI chips. CBS News' Ramy Inocencio traveled to Singapore where China is suspected of exploiting a loophole to access Nvidia chips.

item.title: Iranian women praise singer lashed for not wearing a hijab
item.description: Parastoo Ahmadi was lashed 74 times for the crime of "outraging public decency" after she livestreamed a concert without her hair covered.

item.title: Spacecraft enters Mercury's orbit after 8-year journey despite glitch
item.description: BepiColombo was launched as a joint mission between the European Space Agency and the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency in October 2018.

item.title: Man on cruise ship goes overboard off Bahamas, search underway
item.description: The Allure of the Seas is on an eight-day Thanksgiving cruise in the Caribbean that departed from Miami on Sunday.

item.title: NATO allies anxious as war spreads beyond Ukraine, Russia borders
item.description: As Ukraine attacks Russian ships in far-flung waters, some NATO nations are voicing increasing anxiety over the war's spread to new regions.

item.title: Blanche grilled about Nvidia's Jensen Huang and potential DOJ probes
item.description: Attorney General Todd Blanche held a press conference on the Justice Department's online fraud crackdown, where he also took questions about Nvidia's Jensen Huang and any potential probes into his actions. CBS News' Shanelle Kaul reports.

item.title: Army to detonate unstable explosives in Iowa Wednesday morning
item.description: A federal appeals court on Monday declined to block the Army from detonating explosives containing lead azide at a munitions plant in Iowa.

item.title: Full remarks: Trump officials on plan to detonate toxic lead azide 1 day before Thanksgiving
item.description: Trump administration and military officials spoke on the U.S. Army's plan to detonate thousands of pounds of lead azide in Iowa on Wednesday morning.

item.title: Some AI toys may not be safe for kids. Here's what parents need to know.
item.description: New AI toys, which use generative technology similar to that of chatbots like ChatGPT, have raised concerns among parents of the young kids to whom they're marketed.

item.title: Trump presenting Rudy Giuliani with Presidential Medal of Freedom
item.description: Rudy Giuliani, the former mayor of New York City who worked as a personal lawyer to President Trump, said he will be honored in the Oval Office.

item.title: Cold case murder mystery solved 58 years after girl found dead
item.description: Canadian police say they've solved a teen girl's mysterious murder case, nearly six decades after she was found dead.

item.title: Rep. Omar D.C. home search sought evidence going back to 1980
item.description: The warrant application covers a 46-year period beginning in 1980, long before Omar was in Congress, according to newly released court records. The documents are heavily redacted, and no criminal charges are listed.

item.title: New details emerge about U.S. involvement in drug lord's capture
item.description: The U.S. has sought to line up allies across Latin America to allow U.S. forces to operate in their territories, with mixed responses from across the region.

item.title: Federal court releases Rep. Ilhan Omar D.C. home raid documents
item.description: A federal court on Monday evening released documents regarding last month's raid at the Washington, D.C. home of Democratic Minnesota U.S. Rep. Ilhan Omar.

item.title: Army to detonate toxic chemicals in Iowa a day before Thanksgiving
item.description: The U.S. Army will detonate nearly 10,000 pounds of toxic lead azide on Wednesday morning, an official says. CBS News' Ian Lee reports.

item.title: Meet Sighle Williams, a beloved drive-thru worker and star of a new Netflix documentary
item.description: Sighle Williams, the star of the Netflix short documentary "One Last Order," which comes out Tuesday, joins "CBS Mornings" to talk about her community impact after working 37 years at Mac's Drive Thru in Gainesville, Florida.

item.title: Doctor describes lead, toxic chemical exposure risks as Army plans detonation in Iowa
item.description: The U.S. Army plans to move forward with detonating explosive lead azide in Iowa. Dr. Céline Gounder shares tips for avoiding lead exposure.

item.title: Exclusive discounts from CBS Mornings Deals
item.description: On this edition of CBS Deals, we show you items that could help improve your everyday lifestyle. Visit cbsdeals.com to take advantage of these exclusive deals today. CBS earns commissions on purchases made through cbsdeals.com.

item.title: Forgot to grab wine for Thanksgiving? Here are some last-minute options, according to an expert
item.description: Ray Isle, the wine editor at "Food & Wine," joins "CBS Mornings" to share his favorite affordable picks for a last-minute wine run ahead of Thanksgiving.

item.title: Sneak peek: Jade Colvin is Missing
item.description: ENCORE: Photos discovered on an old cellphone help solve the disappearance of a 14-year-old girl. "48 Hours" correspondent Natalie Morales reports Saturday, Nov. 28 at 9/8c on CBS and streaming on Paramount+.

item.title: Prince William and Kate's country home broken into, 2 arrested
item.description: Intruders have broken into the country residence of Prince William and Princess Catherine, British media reported Tuesday.

item.title: "We're racing towards huge dangers," AI pioneer Yoshua Bengio says
item.description: As one of the "godfathers" of artificial intelligence, Yoshua Bengio helped bring generative AI into the world. Now he worries society isn't ready for what's coming.

item.title: Trump, investors are elated with Huang's return to Nvidia. Lawmakers worry about national security.
item.description: Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO just days after he resigned over an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. CBS News' Olivia Rinaldi reports, plus business contributor Javier David explains how markets are reacting.

item.title: Trump to pardon two turkeys, Freedom and Feathers
item.description: Freedom and Feathers were introduced on Monday at the Willard InterContinental in Washington, where the two have been staying in a suite leading up to their trip to the White House.

item.title: Newly found farthest quasar from Earth is also oldest known to man
item.description: Scientists have discovered the most distant quasar yet, the core of a galaxy with a slow-chomping black hole at its center dating back to nearly the dawn of the universe.

item.title: Democrats announce 12 debates starting in June for 2028 race
item.description: In announcing the debate framework, DNC chair Ken Martin leaned heavily into one of his signature causes, ending dark money in politics.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns in wake of affair, spy scandal
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned effective immediately, the company's board of directors announced Thursday.
